title: Knowledge base
subtitle: Documents the agent may cite. Answers stay inside this material and name the fragment they used.

create.title: Add a document
create.name: Title
create.contentPlaceholder: Paste the policy text. It is split into overlapping fragments so a sentence on a boundary stays retrievable.
create.hint: Text is chunked into ~600 characters with 80 characters of overlap. Existing documents are not replaced.

list.title: Indexed documents
list.empty: No documents yet. Add the first one so answers can cite it.

delete.label: Delete
delete.confirm: Delete “{{title}}” and all of its fragments? Answers will stop citing it.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage the knowledge base.
errors.failed: The knowledge base did not accept that change.

notConfigured: The embedding endpoint is not configured yet, so documents cannot be indexed or searched. An administrator can add it under System settings → knowledge.
